classes.why_not_edge_repairable: At least one strict frozen-scorer parent/daughter role is absent from the prediction graph. An edge-only or division-fork realizer cannot connect a node that does not exist, so these events require upstream detection/localization role recovery.

classes.why_not_in_38_bundle: All strict roles exist and a component already spans the parent and both daughter lineages, but the graph has no eligible local fork. The D1 direct action compiled through frozen N1; it was deliberately suppressed because only one branch had the required daughter/grandchild persistence evidence.

conclusion: The four false negatives are not one motif. They split into three upstream role-absence cases and one already-connected but locally forkless, nonpersistent case. Both are outside the 38-event fragmented-graph target and are proposed only as separate future diagnostic nodes.
